Tested this by hash comparison: pulled input_csv_sha256 from the FFW_B3 receipt and dataset_local_csv_sha256 from the parent ML B4 model receipt, and raw_sha256/quarantined/rights_class from the module's own acquisition-receipt.json, normalized-dataset manifest.json, and rights.json for the Polyverse melt-viscosity dataset. Fire 1's 'no rights review needed' assertion is therefore false: re-running the harness to emit new per-row derivative arrays would re-consume the identical quarantined CSV and create a new derivative squarely inside the quarantine-all-derivatives basis.

fires.action: Final permitted fire (3 of 3). Re-verified the rights.json decision.decision_receipt for the Polyverse melt-viscosity dataset is still null (counsel review still pending, unchanged since fire 2). Re-ran a freshness scan across the fixed 9-file FFW-vs-ML signed lineage for any length-13/length-194 array -- zero hits -- and validated the scanner with a positive control (planted a decoy 13-element array, confirmed detection) so the clean scan cannot be mistaken for a broken one. Evaluated the item's honest re-scope hatch (available this fire per the done_criterion's len(fires)>=max_fires-1 clause and flagged in fire 2's next_fire_should): tested the only analytic method needing no per-row data (Olkin & Finn 1995 asymptotic R^2 variance formula) against the published aggregate KPI numbers. Found it unsound on this specific claim in three independent ways: (1) using n=194 rows silently drops the clustering the cluster bootstrap exists to respect (SE=0.0434, an order of magnitude too tight); (2) substituting n=13 clusters into the same row-level-derived formula is a relabeling, not a valid cluster-robust derivation (SE=0.1081, no defensible sampling interpretation); (3) B4's fitted-parameter count was never persisted as an integer ('many (histogram GBM leaves)'), so degrees-of-freedom is undefined at n=13. Did not report any fabricated interval.
fires.result: BLOCKED_RIGHTS (terminal for this item -- 3 of 3 fires exhausted). Rights block unchanged from fire 2; the re-scope hatch was evaluated in good faith and explicitly declined as statistically unsound rather than invoked with a fabricated number.
